title: driver-harness-mcp user configuration
description: Per-user configuration consumed by driver-harness-mcp's MCP server and its AI skills. Copy driver-harness.config.example.json to driver-harness.config.json and fill in your real values.

vm.description: The VMware Workstation guest VM this harness controls.

vmx_path.description: Absolute path to the guest's .vmx file. Example: E:\VMs\test-vm\test-vm.vmx

baseline_snapshot.description: Name of the VMware snapshot the harness reverts to before every test run. MUST already exist.

guest.description: Credentials and paths inside the guest VM.

admin_user.description: Guest OS administrator username. vmrun -gu/-gp will use this.

admin_password.description: Guest admin password. Supports ${env:VAR_NAME} syntax to reference an environment variable instead of writing the password literally. vmrun does NOT accept empty passwords.

desktop_path.description: Writable directory inside the guest for staging driver binaries.

arch.description: Guest CPU architecture. Most kernel debugging work happens on x64.

os_version_hint.description: Optional hint for skills to pick the right offsets/patterns. Examples: win10_19041, win11_22631.

host.description: Tool paths on the host. Empty strings mean 'let the AI probe and fill in.'

vmrun_path.description: Absolute path to vmrun.exe. Empty string = let AI probe default locations.

vmmon64_path.description: Absolute path to VirtualKD-Redux's vmmon64.exe. Empty string = let AI probe; if probing fails, ask the user for the path. Starting/restarting vmmon64.exe and writing HKLM work best from an elevated/admin agent session.

vmnet8_ip.description: Host IP on VMware NAT network (VMnet8). Only needed for native KDNET, not for VirtualKD-Redux setups.

symbols_path.description: Local directory used as WinDbg's symbol cache.

flags.description: Boolean hints telling the AI which setup steps have already been completed. Set them to true after you've done each one so the AI doesn't nag you.

guest_testsigning_enabled.description: True once `bcdedit /set testsigning on` has been run inside the guest and it rebooted.

guest_kdnet_configured.description: True once native KDNET has been set up inside the guest.

guest_vkd_installed.description: True once VirtualKD-Redux's guest driver has been installed in the guest.

baseline_snapshot_created.description: True once you've taken the baseline snapshot named `vm.baseline_snapshot`.
